does: Scores for the AI the stats functors of one spell: clamps the spell's ranges through its eoc::spell::ModificationContainerComponent, scores the functors with CalculateAiScoreStatsFunctors, and scores again with a second functor set when the spell has one, adding both into the result.

evidence.says: creates an AiScore, reads the ModificationContainerComponent of the spell's source, calls CalculateAiScoreStatsFunctors once or twice and merges with weight 1.0
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 16 places in the AI decision code, about 17 800 calls

questions.ask: the name rests on the order of the Toolkit's names and on the spell modifications it reads; a probe of +0x3116500 with a goblin casting a known spell would tie the call to the spell id
